feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: MPs to probe role of private equity on high street after Poundland collapse
articles.summary: The role of private equity firms in reshaping Britain's high streets is to be probed by parliament after the collapse of Poundland this week put more than 10,000 jobs at risk.

articles.title: Centrica warns on jobs after government snubs Rough gas storage deal
articles.summary: The FTSE-100 utility Centrica has warned that hundreds of jobs at its Rough gas storage facility off the Yorkshire coast are at risk and claimed that ministers had rejected proposals to bolster Britain's energy security.

articles.title: MoD can't find contact details for half of veterans
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence has published open letters to almost 100,000 veterans about their duty to mobilise in a crisis but it appears unable to find many people's direct contact details.

articles.title: MoD 'severely lacks expertise' to improve military housing
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence lacks the skills and expertise needed to overhaul poor-quality housing for armed forces families, MPs have warned.

articles.title: Amazon staff to strike and rally on busiest weekend of the year
articles.summary: Amazon employees around the world are set to stage protests on Black Friday amid claims of unfair pay and oppressive working conditions.

articles.title: 'The cold's here to stay': Snow possible - with ice warning issued
articles.summary: Snow could hit northern areas of the UK over the next few days, while a yellow ice warning has been issued in parts of the country.

articles.title: Security incident reported at Royal Navy headquarters
articles.summary: Police responded to what appears to have been a hoax bomb threat at a Royal Navy training site.

articles.title: Charity set up in honour of Princess Diana placed into administration
articles.summary: A charity set up in tribute to the late Princess Diana has been placed into administration.
